regions.today: A cool morning with plenty of crisp sunshine but a little lingering cloud too. Some early fog will quickly clear away with largely dry weather continuing through the afternoon and evening. Perhaps feeling a little chilly at times with highs of 10 to 13 degrees and light winds.
regions.tonight: Cool, calm and clear heading into the evening with dry weather throughout. A little cloud will drift in at times later tonight with some mist and fog patches forming. Rather chilly too with lows 1 to 4 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: A chilly but bright and sunny morning with a little lingering mist or fog clearing. Staying mostly dry too with a touch of cloud drifting in later in the morning with some light rain or drizzle at times. Highs of 10 to 13 degrees.
